lines.zh: 我走路没有声音，只有冷气。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, only cold air.

lines.zh: 袍子下面没有脚，只有一缕雾。
lines.en: No feet under my robe, only a wisp of mist.

lines.zh: 我飘过摊位，货跟着浮起来。
lines.en: I drift past the stalls; my wares float along.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在别人的影子上。
lines.en: Every step lands on someone else's shadow.

lines.zh: 风推着我走，我只是顺着。
lines.en: The wind pushes me along; I merely yield.

lines.zh: 我的裙摆扫过地面，霜就化了。
lines.en: My hem brushes the ground and the frost melts.

lines.zh: 走过三盏灯，我的形体才稳住。
lines.en: Three lanterns past, my form finally steadies.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我的雾会沾上你。
lines.en: Not too close; my mist clings.

lines.zh: 我在找一处灵脉，顺便卖点东西。
lines.en: I seek a spirit vein, and sell a little on the way.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的魂，走远了会散。
lines.en: A fifteen-heart soul scatters if it strays.

lines.zh: 我走过的草，第二天会长得歪。
lines.en: Grass I cross grows crooked by morning.

lines.zh: 脚不落地，价却落得实在。
lines.en: My feet never land, but my prices do.

lines.zh: 我在听风里有没有游魂。
lines.en: I listen for wandering souls in the wind.

lines.zh: 摊上这些货，每一件都住着东西。
lines.en: Every item on my stall houses something.

lines.zh: 别碰那串珠子，它昨夜才安静。
lines.en: Don't touch those beads; they calmed only last night.

lines.zh: 我在数今天收来的灵。
lines.en: I count the spirits collected today.

lines.zh: 香烧完了，我就得补货。
lines.en: When the incense burns out, I must restock.

lines.zh: 这具形体是借的，不能久站。
lines.en: This form is borrowed; it cannot stand long.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，比常人快一点。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, a little quick.

lines.zh: 安静，那口箱子在敲盖子。
lines.en: Quiet; that crate is knocking its lid.

lines.zh: 我把灵契一张张摊平晾着。
lines.en: I lay the spirit contracts out to dry.

lines.zh: 没人来买，游魂倒是来了三只。
lines.en: No buyers came, but three souls drifted in.

lines.zh: 我守着摊子，也守着这些不肯走的。
lines.en: I keep the stall, and those who will not leave.

lines.zh: 蜡烛换了七根，天还没亮。
lines.en: Seven candles changed, and still no dawn.

lines.zh: 我的货不标价，只标契约年限。
lines.en: My goods show contract years, not prices.

lines.zh: 你别站在下风口，会做噩梦。
lines.en: Don't stand downwind; you will have nightmares.

lines.zh: 我把秤砣摆正，它偏了半分。
lines.en: I straighten the scale weight. It leans half a mark.

lines.zh: 有个新来的魂，还不会说话。
lines.en: A new soul arrived and cannot speak yet.

lines.zh: 你身上有三道旧伤，两道不是刀。
lines.en: Three old wounds on you; two not from blades.

lines.zh: 我看看你的影子，它比你老实。
lines.en: Let me look at your shadow; it is more honest.

lines.zh: 你的魂很亮，亮得有点吵。
lines.en: Your soul is bright, and rather loud.

lines.zh: 别避开我的眼睛，我在读契。
lines.en: Don't avoid my eyes; I am reading your contract.

lines.zh: 你身后跟着什么，自己知道吗？
lines.en: Do you know what follows behind you?

lines.zh: 你的手很冷，碰过不该碰的东西。
lines.en: Your hands are cold; you touched something forbidden.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种眼神，来买护身符的。
lines.en: I know that look: you came for a charm.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我的雾进了你肺里。
lines.en: Your breath falters; my mist is in your lungs.

lines.zh: 站定，让我数清你有几重影。
lines.en: Stand still and let me count your shadows.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个来找我的人。
lines.en: You are not the first to seek me out.

lines.zh: 你的名字写在额头上，很淡。
lines.en: Your name is written on your brow, faintly.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，就少收你一枚。
lines.en: One look at you and I knock off a coin.

lines.zh: 别握拳，魂会被自己捏疼。
lines.en: Don't clench your fists; souls bruise that way.

lines.zh: 你带着铁器，铁会赶跑我的货。
lines.en: You carry iron; iron scares off my wares.

lines.zh: 这具身体裂了，魂还连着一半。
lines.en: This body splits; half the soul still holds.

lines.zh: 碎的是借来的壳，我还在。
lines.en: The borrowed shell shattered; I am still here.

lines.zh: 我疼得很远，像从别的屋子传来。
lines.en: The pain is distant, as from another room.

lines.zh: 别打第二下，契会松。
lines.en: Not a second blow; the contract loosens.

lines.zh: 血是冷的，流出来像水银。
lines.en: My blood is cold and runs like quicksilver.

lines.zh: 我借来的骨头断了一根。
lines.en: One of my borrowed bones has broken.

lines.zh: 这一下让摊上的魂都醒了。
lines.en: That blow woke every soul on my stall.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的形体，我还能拼。
lines.en: You broke my form; I can still reassemble.

lines.zh: 疼会留在你手上，洗不掉的。
lines.en: The pain stays on your hand; it won't wash off.

lines.zh: 我退一步，雾就薄一层。
lines.en: I step back and my mist thins a layer.

lines.zh: 那枚骨片，我愿意用两张契换。
lines.en: For that bone shard I will trade two contracts.

lines.zh: 你袋里有灵在叫，放它出来。
lines.en: Something in your bag is calling; let it out.

lines.zh: 这块石头吸过血，我出高价。
lines.en: This stone has drunk blood; I pay well.

lines.zh: 把你的旧护符给我，它累了。
lines.en: Give me your old charm; it is tired.

lines.zh: 那缕头发，是谁的？我收。
lines.en: Whose hair is that? I will buy it.

lines.zh: 你捡到的东西，比你想的值钱。
lines.en: What you found is worth more than you think.

lines.zh: 别把瓶子晃，里面的东西会晕。
lines.en: Don't shake the vial; the thing inside gets dizzy.

lines.zh: 我闻到契约的味道，你身上有。
lines.en: I smell a contract on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，烧的是别人的魂。
lines.en: That lantern burns someone else's soul.

lines.zh: 给我三滴血，这张契就归你。
lines.en: Three drops of blood and this contract is yours.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的雾，我凉了半截。
lines.en: You pass through my mist and half of me chills.

lines.zh: 别道歉，我本来就没有实体。
lines.en: No apology; I have no solid body.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我左边的胳膊。
lines.en: You scattered my left arm.

lines.zh: 往后退，我的契纸被你踩了。
lines.en: Step back; you tread on my contracts.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的影子留在我这儿了。
lines.en: That bump left your shadow with me.

lines.zh: 我们错身时，你打了个寒颤吧。
lines.en: When we passed, you shivered, didn't you?

lines.zh: 我的雾沾上你的袖子，洗不掉。
lines.en: My mist stains your sleeve; it won't wash out.

lines.zh: 轻些，我借来的骨头很脆。
lines.en: Gently; these borrowed bones are brittle.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，撞得我发麻。
lines.en: The iron on you makes me numb.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我的货经不起碰。
lines.en: Half a step aside; my wares cannot take knocks.

lines.zh: 灵与灵不相配，只看契合不合。
lines.en: Spirits don't match; only contracts do.

lines.zh: 我上一份契，签了三百年。
lines.en: My last contract ran three hundred years.

lines.zh: 别谈情，谈年限。
lines.en: Skip affection; discuss duration.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣早已散成雾了。
lines.en: My mate scattered into mist long ago.

lines.zh: 你若签下名字，我或许留下。
lines.en: Sign your name and I might stay.

lines.zh: 灵没有子嗣，只有继承的契。
lines.en: Spirits have no children, only inherited contracts.

lines.zh: 离我远些，我身上的冷会伤你。
lines.en: Keep away; my cold will hurt you.

lines.zh: 这事要问过摊上的七只魂。
lines.en: Ask the seven souls on my stall first.

lines.zh: 我连自己的形体都保不住。
lines.en: I cannot even hold my own form together.

lines.zh: 别把香灰撒我身上，那是聘礼吗？
lines.en: Don't scatter ash on me; is that a dowry?

lines.zh: 掉下来的契纸，我一张张捡。
lines.en: I gather the fallen contracts one by one.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币上有汗，归你了。
lines.en: That coin carries sweat; it is yours.

lines.zh: 别捡那张纸，上面的名字还在动。
lines.en: Don't pick up that page; the name still moves.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，雾会散一会儿。
lines.en: When I bend, my mist thins for a moment.

lines.zh: 捡起来，先别念上面的字。
lines.en: Pick it up, but do not read the words yet.

lines.zh: 这块碎片原本是我摊位的一部分。
lines.en: That shard used to be part of my stall.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不用手，用风。
lines.en: I pick things up with wind, not hands.

lines.zh: 掉了就掉了，灵不会摔死。
lines.en: Dropped is dropped; spirits don't die from falls.

lines.zh: 你捡到的那颗珠子，先还我。
lines.en: Return the bead you picked up.

lines.zh: 捡货时别出声，会惊到里面。
lines.en: Stay silent while gathering; it startles what's inside.

lines.zh: 那个人身上有未结的契。
lines.en: That one carries an unsettled contract.

lines.zh: 我闻到恐惧，是好客人。
lines.en: I smell fear; a fine customer.

lines.zh: 他影子多出一层，跟了东西。
lines.en: His shadow has an extra layer; something follows.

lines.zh: 目标来了，我把最贵的摆前面。
lines.en: Target arrives; I move my dearest goods forward.

lines.zh: 先看他敢不敢直视我的脸。
lines.en: First see whether he dares meet my face.

lines.zh: 这人的魂有裂缝，正好做生意。
lines.en: This soul has cracks, perfect for business.

lines.zh: 我把契纸翻到有他名字那页。
lines.en: I turn the contracts to the page with his name.

lines.zh: 别惊动他，让他自己走过来。
lines.en: Don't startle him; let him come closer.

lines.zh: 他手上的旧疤，是拿命换的。
lines.en: Those scars were bought with his life.

lines.zh: 我盯上他了，他还没察觉。
lines.en: I have marked him; he has not noticed.

lines.zh: 这个客人，值得我点一根新香。
lines.en: This one merits a fresh stick of incense.

lines.zh: 目标很简单：让他签下名字。
lines.en: The aim is simple: get his name signed.

lines.zh: 我看着你，你看着我的货。
lines.en: I watch you; you watch my goods.

lines.zh: 别回头，你的影子在我手里。
lines.en: Don't look back; your shadow is in my hands.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越慢，很好。
lines.en: Your breathing slows; good.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就会想买。
lines.en: I count to three and you will want to buy.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不在脸上，在你背后。
lines.en: My eyes are not in my face but behind you.

lines.zh: 站住，让我把契念完。
lines.en: Stand still while I finish the contract.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，我看得见那道缝。
lines.en: You hesitate; I see the gap in you.

lines.zh: 别摸护符，它挡不住我。
lines.en: Don't touch your charm; it won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的魂了，只是很轻。
lines.en: I have your soul fixed, very lightly.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的雾就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my mist follows.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的名字，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I am after your name, not your face.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，契就自己成了。
lines.en: Stand a moment longer and the contract forms itself.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是在称你的魂。
lines.en: Don't fear; I am only weighing your soul.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打人，只擅长收尾。
lines.en: I am poor at striking, good at finishing.

lines.zh: 这一掌下去，你的手会冷三天。
lines.en: This palm will leave your hand cold three days.

lines.zh: 别逼我动用契里的东西。
lines.en: Don't make me use what is in the contract.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的魂，打你一下也够。
lines.en: A fifteen-heart soul can still land one hit.

lines.zh: 我的手从你的护甲缝里穿过去。
lines.en: My hand slips through the seams of your armor.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的咒，代价不轻。
lines.en: You broke my incantation; that costs.

lines.zh: 我这一碰，是往你骨头里碰。
lines.en: This touch goes into your bones.

lines.zh: 退后，我不想把契弄脏。
lines.en: Back off; I don't want the contract soiled.

lines.zh: 打不过你，我就把你的名字划掉。
lines.en: If I cannot beat you, I erase your name.

lines.zh: 我的手没有温度，但很硬。
lines.en: My hand has no warmth, but it is hard.

lines.zh: 我从灯焰里出来，带着一张旧契。
lines.en: I come out of the flame bearing an old contract.

lines.zh: 先把香点上，我才能站稳。
lines.en: Light the incense first so I can stand firm.

lines.zh: 这地方灵脉浅，只能摆个小摊。
lines.en: The spirit vein here is shallow; a small stall only.

lines.zh: 我把七只游魂系在摊角。
lines.en: I tie seven wandering souls to the stall corners.

lines.zh: 天没黑，我就已经在了。
lines.en: The sun has not set, and I am already here.

lines.zh: 摊布是纸做的，写着别人的名。
lines.en: My cloth is paper, bearing others' names.

lines.zh: 我从梦里被叫醒，来得很急。
lines.en: I was woken from a dream and came in haste.

lines.zh: 第一根蜡烛点着，生意就开了。
lines.en: The first candle lights and business begins.

lines.zh: 这里死过人，正好适合我。
lines.en: Someone died here; ideal for me.

lines.zh: 我的货刚从雾里捞出来。
lines.en: My wares were just fished out of the mist.

lines.zh: 别踩那圈灰，那是我画的界。
lines.en: Don't cross that ash ring; it is my boundary.

lines.zh: 我来收这地方散掉的魂。
lines.en: I come to collect the souls shed here.

lines.zh: 摊位一立，风就停了。
lines.en: The stall goes up and the wind stops.

lines.zh: 七盏灯亮起，我才算真的到了。
lines.en: Seven lamps lit and I have truly arrived.

lines.zh: 火不认识我，照样烧我的契。
lines.en: Fire does not know me, yet burns my contracts.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，落地时散成一片雾。
lines.en: I fall and scatter into mist on landing.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我快记不清名字。
lines.en: Water thins me; I am forgetting my name.

lines.zh: 炸开的火星把我撕成好几股。
lines.en: The blast tears me into several strands.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一个不会合的洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, leaving a hole that won't close.

lines.zh: 别人的咒压过来，我的契在发烫。
lines.en: Another's spell presses in; my contracts burn.

lines.zh: 没有香火，我连话都说不响。
lines.en: Without incense, I can barely make a sound.

lines.zh: 雷把我钉在地上，动不了。
lines.en: Lightning pins me to the ground.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有灵，我在往下散。
lines.en: No spirits in the void; I am scattering downward.
